name: sol-advisor
description: Codex-native workflow with six GPT-6 lanes: Luna floor and implementation, Luna narrow retry, Sol broad implementation and review, and read-only Astra consultation.

interface.shortDescription: Route mechanical, standard, retry, broad integration, review, and premise-reframing work to the six GPT-6 role lanes.
interface.longDescription: Sol Advisor provides six purpose-built GPT-6 lanes: Luna / low for mechanical edits, Luna / high for ordinary implementation, Luna / max for narrow retries, Sol / medium for broad integration and senior escalations, read-only Sol / medium for budgeted final review, and read-only Astra / medium for reframing premises and high-consequence decisions.
defaultPrompt: Use Sol Advisor to build this feature and verify it before completion.
Classify this task with Sol Advisor and route it to the right implementation lane.
Review this deliverable with a fresh Sol reviewer before reporting done.
